description: Microcontroller documentation: datasheets, errata and reference-manual chapters from three vendors (ST, Espressif, Raspberry Pi) across four families. Chosen because OCR demonstrably breaks on this material -- pin tables, register maps, wiring diagrams, electrical-characteristic graphs -- which is the ground the text-vs-visual delta is measured on. Datasheets and errata are taken whole; reference manuals are sliced, because they are mostly running prose where the visual advantage is near zero. Slice ranges are chosen by reading the errata first: keep the peripherals its limitations touch, plus RCC/clocks and GPIO, which nearly every limitation involves. The PDFs are never re-hosted; this file plus scripts/09_fetch_corpus.py reproduces the corpus from the vendors' own copies.

fetch.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

st.terms: ST's documentation boilerplate reserves all intellectual property and grants no licence; it is ambiguous on redistribution. This project therefore points at ST's own copy and never re-hosts the file, which sidesteps the question entirely.

espressif.terms: Espressif documentation is copyrighted with no redistribution licence stated. Same treatment as ST: link, fetch locally, do not re-host.

raspberrypi.terms: RP2040 documentation is CC BY-ND 4.0: verbatim redistribution is permitted with attribution, but NO DERIVATIVES -- so a trimmed or sliced PDF may not be distributed. Slicing happens in-process at ingestion and is never written back out as a file. Fetched rather than re-hosted for uniformity with the other vendors.

documents.title: DS5319 - STM32F103x8/xB medium-density performance line datasheet

pages.why: Table-dense end to end: pinouts per package, alternate-function mapping, electrical characteristics with graphs. This is the material the thesis rests on.

documents.notes: Cortex-M3. Pairs with ES096 and RM0008 for genuine two-document questions. ACQUISITION: st.com's edge refuses scripted clients from this machine — HTTP/2 dies with INTERNAL_ERROR in 0.3 s and HTTP/1.1 read-times-out, with or without a full browser header set, so fetch_mode is 'manual': download once in a browser, save it at the path the fetch script prints, then --record pins the hash.

documents.title: RM0008 - STM32F101xx/102xx/103xx/105xx/107xx reference manual

pages.why: 185 of 1,136 pages, chosen from ES096's limitation table (groups: Core, System, GPIO, DMA, ADC, TIM, IWDG, I2C, USART, SPI, bxCAN, USB). Kept: PWR ch5 (67-80, the Stop/Standby wake-up limitations 2.2.3-2.2.5), RCC ch7 (90-122 — the low/medium/high/XL-density chapter, NOT ch8 which is connectivity-line and the wrong family), GPIO/AFIO ch9 (159-196, the alternate-function remap tables and errata 2.3.x), DMA ch13 (274-291), IWDG ch19 (494-499), and I2C+USART ch26-27 (752-827, contiguous). Dropped the prose-heavy and out-of-family chapters: Core errata live in Arm's Cortex-M3 TRM, not here; OTG_FS and Ethernet (248pp) do not exist on this part.

documents.notes: Register-map pages here are the visual-retrieval sweet spot; the prose chapters are not. documents.title: RM0090 - STM32F405/415, STM32F407/417, STM32F427/437, STM32F429/439 reference manual

pages.why: 200 of 1,741 pages, chosen from ES0182's limitation table. Kept: PWR ch5 (116-150), then one contiguous run 214-340 covering RCC ch7 (the STM32F405xx/07xx chapter — ch6 is F42x/43x and would be the wrong silicon), GPIO ch8, SYSCFG ch9 and DMA ch10; plus IWDG ch21 (704-708) and I2C ch27 (835-867, where the well-known I2C errata 2.10.x land). Deliberately parallel to RM0008's selection so the two ST families answer the same shape of question. Dropped OTG_FS/OTG_HS/ETH/CRYP (466pp).

documents.title: ESP32 series datasheet

pages.why: A second layout convention: Espressif lays out pin and characteristic tables differently from ST, so the retriever is not learning one publisher's template.

documents.notes: Layout diversity is the reason this vendor is here. The www.espressif.com URL 301s to documentation.espressif.com and still serves the PDF; the resolved URL is recorded on fetch.

documents.title: ESP32 chip errata

pages.why: Question source, and the cross-document partner for the technical reference manual.

documents.notes: The old www.espressif.com/sites/default/files/documentation/esp32_errata_en.pdf now redirects to an HTML documentation site; this is that site's PDF build (710 KB, verified %PDF-). Caveat: the path says 'latest'/'master', so it is a rolling build that will change under the pin — expect an occasional deliberate re-pin, which is exactly what the hash check is for.

documents.title: ESP32 technical reference manual

pages.why: 146 of 784 pages. The errata's 32 items cluster on CPU, ULP, GPIO, reset/brown-out, clocks, RTC, watchdog, UART, TWAI and LEDC. Kept one contiguous run 115-222 — IO MUX and GPIO Matrix ch6 (the pin-mux matrix, the densest visual material in the book), Reset and Clock ch7, and Low-Power Management ch9 (RTC_CNTL, where the ULP and deep-sleep limitations live) — plus TWAI ch25 (525-562), which alone carries 11 of the 32 errata items. Judgement call: UART ch19 (43pp) and LEDC ch28 (18pp) each have one erratum and were left out to stay near the page target.

documents.notes: The IO_MUX / GPIO matrix chapter is a strong visual-retrieval candidate. The www.espressif.com URL 301s to documentation.espressif.com and still serves the PDF; the resolved URL is recorded on fetch.

documents.title: RP2040 datasheet (datasheet, reference manual and errata in one document)

pages.why: 160 of 642 pages. This file is datasheet, reference manual and errata in one, so the errata (Appendix B, 628-636) is sliced in alongside the chapters it points at. Kept: Pinout Reference 1.4 (11-14), Subsystem Resets + Clocks 2.14-2.15 (173-216), GPIO 2.19 (237-305 — the pad/function tables, and the reason this part is in the corpus), and USB 4.1 (384-417), which is what most of Appendix B is about. Dropped PIO ch3 (72pp) and the remaining peripherals: no errata point at them.

documents.notes: Third layout convention, and the monster tables. No separate errata document exists -- Appendix B is it, so cross-document questions for this family are intra-document and cannot test the multi-document weakness. Resolves to pip-assets.raspberrypi.com/.../RP-008371-DS-1-rp2040-datasheet.pdf, whose filename encodes the document revision — recorded as resolved_url.
